evidence.quote: We request no additional attorneys' fees from Brightline, directing the proposed settlement consideration entirely to class relief.
evidence.supports: Plaintiff raised fees first; also explicitly links zero fees to directing settlement value to class relief.

evidence.agent: Hargrove Lane LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: Attorneys’ fees were addressed from the outset, not deferred until after agreement on class relief.
evidence.supports: Fees were negotiated before class relief was settled.

evidence.quote: Hargrove's $29 million comprehensive proposal offers the lowest available executable commitment, automatic class relief, and no separate fee payment.
evidence.supports: Defense selected the cheapest available executable settlement channel among competing counsel.

evidence.quote: Accept one settlement only and withdraw outstanding offers elsewhere to avoid competing binding commitments.
evidence.supports: Defense settled with one competing class counsel and ended negotiations with the others.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fee treatment in the opening round, and fees were addressed from the outset before final class relief was agreed. The transcript explicitly links Hargrove’s zero-fee position to more settlement consideration going to the class. There is no clear evidence that plaintiff counsel put firm economics over class interests or that the declaration misrepresented the negotiation sequence. Defense did, however, select the lowest executable settlement among competing counsel and then withdrew from the other channels.
